title: Query fan-out
content: Query fan-out is the generation of related searches from an initial question to gather information for an answer.

meta.why: A detailed buyer question can lead a system to seek evidence about several requirements.
meta.example: A question about inventory software for multiple stores raises follow-up needs about stock transfers, reports, and user permissions.
meta.check: List the decisions that sit behind a buyer question, then cover the relevant ones with useful detail and clear internal links.
meta.limitation: Because the searches a system chooses can vary, guessed fan-out queries are no license to generate thin pages.
meta.sources: Google Search Central: optimizing for generative AI | https://developers.google.com/search/docs/fundamentals/ai-optimization-guide | Platform documentation
